title: ESIIPayment Native Provider Capabilities
description: Describes one provider whose behaviour is implemented as native code per language runtime, rather than as a manifest.yaml this repository's DSL can express. See spec/03-manifest-dsl.md#native-providers for the five signals that mean a provider needs this path instead of manifest.yaml. Carries only identity, credential shape, and capability metadata — never call/flow/error mechanics, since those live in each language's native implementation, not here.

provider.description: Unique slug identifying this provider. Must match the directory name providers/<provider>/.

spec_version.description: The spec version this provider targets, e.g. "1.0". See spec/08-versioning.md.

implementation.description: Always the literal "native": marks this provider as implemented as code per language runtime rather than as manifest.yaml. This is the only field that distinguishes this file from a manifest.yaml-driven provider at a glance.

display_name.description: Human-readable provider name shown in the generated catalog and in credential-input UI.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the provider's primary market, e.g. "ET".

currencies.description: ISO-4217 currency codes this provider can move. Every code listed must have an entry in vectors/money/exponents.json.

shape.description: The closed CredentialShape this provider uses, for generic credential-input-form generation. See spec/01-domain-model.md#credentialshape. A native implementation performs the actual credential application/token exchange in code; auth.apply/auth.token (manifest.yaml's mechanism for that) do not apply here.

fields.description: Named credential fields the runtime must collect from the integrator, same rules as manifest.yaml's auth.fields (empty iff shape is "none"; Invariant I9: never a literal secret value).

operations.description: The Operation values this provider supports. Every value here must have cassette coverage under cassettes/, same as a manifest.yaml-driven provider.

next_actions.description: Every NextAction variant this provider's native implementation can emit. Unlike a manifest.yaml, esiipayment validate cannot cross-check this against flows (there are none to check); it is asserted by the native implementation's own conformance suite instead.
